channel.title: Sketchbook Kitchen · recipes
channel.description: Illustrated cookbooks by BenizTor: recipes in grams, drawn in watercolor.

item.title: Mocha
item.description: Coffee in the cake and espresso in the buttercream. For anyone who takes dessert with a double shot. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Hazelnut-Stuffed Cocoa
item.description: A dark cocoa cookie with a molten hazelnut spread centre. Freezing the filling first is what keeps it inside. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Zaban (Puff Pastry Tongues)
item.description: Flaky tongue-shaped puff pastries from Qazvin, brushed with honey and rosewater and sprinkled with pistachio. A nostalgic Nowruz favourite. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Bûche de Noël
item.description: A light chocolate sponge rolled around vanilla mascarpone cream and covered in ganache bark. The French Christmas log. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Double Chocolate Ganache
item.description: Chocolate cake with melting chips inside, dipped in a glossy dark ganache. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Giant Walnut Chocolate Chunk
item.description: Tall, craggy and gooey in the middle. Cold butter, a hot oven and heavy dough balls are what keep these cookies thick. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Koloocheh (Fuman Walnut Cookies)
item.description: Stamped round cookies from the town of Fuman in Gilan, filled with cinnamon and walnut. Travellers on the road north stop for them warm. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Chocolate Peppermint Sandwiches
item.description: Dark chocolate cookies with a cool peppermint cream and crushed candy canes rolled around the edge. Coming soon in The Holiday Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Marble
item.description: Swirls of vanilla and chocolate batter in every cupcake, so no two look alike. Coming soon in The Cupcake Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Chewy Molasses Spice
item.description: Dark, chewy and crackled, with ginger, cinnamon and a hint of clove. Coarse sugar on the outside gives each one a sparkle and a crunch. Coming soon in The Cookie Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Nan-e Kermanshahi (Kermanshah Butter Cookies)
item.description: Rich, golden butter cookies from western Iran, traditionally made with the region's famous ghee, finished with sesame. Coming soon in The Persian Sweets Sketchbook. Written in grams, illustrated in watercolor.

item.title: Sketchbook Kitchen: illustrated cookbooks by BenizTor
item.description: Recipes in grams, drawn in watercolor. Free recipes and all the books at beniztor.com.
